title: knowledge.learned and knowledge.retracted, as Fabric Inbox emits them
description: B-161: a change of what reply agents answer from, on the server's events feed (/fabric/v1/events, list_agent_events) as data.value. knowledge.learned: a knowledge document added or changed, or an agent's own knowledge text changed; knowledge.retracted: a document removed. A new version is a new ref. addresses are the Cloudflare addresses and connected accounts whose agents read it, so a reader takes only its own mailboxes. answer is the knowledge text as saved, never a sender's words; validatedBy says who saved it: operator (a person signed in to the server), agent (an agent key) or unknown (local development). workers/agents/knowledge-events.ts.

questions.description: A document's title; empty for an agent's own knowledge text.

truncated.description: The text was longer than 8000 characters and is cut.
